defects: All cells, central face: the eyes are smaller, sharper, and more heavily outlined than REF, weakening the soft Memoji likeness and making her feel like a different production model.
r1c2, mouth and lower face: the oversized vertical mouth cavity stretches without corresponding cheek or jaw deformation, creating a cheap swap-mouth effect.
r2c1, eyes and mouth: the extreme smile, uneven squint, and rigid lower face push delight toward manic; the expression lacks premium cheek compression.
r3c2, eyelids: both half-lids are mechanically identical and paired with a settled smile, so this reads as sleepy or smug rather than a transitional blink.
r3c3, nose/eyes/mouth: the features do not rotate consistently with the skull; the far eye remains too frontal and the nose and mouth barely shift, exposing the puppet construction.
top_fix: Rebuild the facial rig around REF-accurate eye scale and softer geometry, then add coordinated cheek, jaw, nose, and far-side feature deformation so open mouths, blinks, and head turns feel volumetric rather than swapped 2D parts.
